title: Flag Adoption Proclamation
issuing_authority: Melvin Varghese, Chief Architect, The Bhoomi Federation
summary: Adopts a vertical blue-white-green triband and records its stated colors, proportions, symbolism, and protocols of use.

title: National Day Proclamation
issuing_authority: Melvin Varghese, Chief Architect, The Bhoomi Federation
summary: Identifies 5 June as the Federation's inception and says it shall be observed annually as National Day.

title: Founding Proclamation
issuing_authority: Melvin Varghese, Chief Architect, The Bhoomi Federation
summary: Declares the Bhoomi Federation formally established, names 5 June 2025 as its foundation date, and lists four founding values.

title: On the Official Designation of Citizens of the Bhoomi Federation
issuing_authority: Melvin Varghese, Chief Architect, The Bhoomi Federation
summary: Designates people granted citizenship under the stated legal and administrative framework as Bhoomians.

title: Adoption of the Official National Calendar
issuing_authority: Melvin Varghese, Chief Architect, The Bhoomi Federation
summary: Lists Monday through Friday as working days, weekends as non-working days, and 5 June as the sole public holiday; it says government offices remain closed on that day.
